objective: Corporate-owned pretrade anonymous note reservations followed by seven resident MPC nodes producing the exact zkPI and native application certificate accepted by five live Avalanche DeFMI validators.
hard_constraints: Reserve is finalized before the corporate process distributes any order shares.
Coordinator has no corporate wallet seeds, facility openings or DeFMI issuer signing key.
Matching nodes receive redacted admissions, not canonical note references or raw orders.
Matched threshold handoff contains reservation authority only, not a raw order.
No post-match participant signature and no coordinator replacement proof.
Native DeFMI checks full monetary proofs, exact reserved heads, committee certificates and replay protection.
All execution is on Softbank or Omen; one-host containers are not WAN or independent operators.
truth_provider: Actual corporate containers, seven malicious-shamir MP-SPDZ containers, and canonical RPC readbacks from five live Avalanche validators.
verification: native receipt and unchanged root on exact retry
maker active remaining hold and taker closed hold
private book advances only after native finality
non_claims: One functional scenario is smoke evidence, not performance or economic evidence.
Lab provisioning generates keys centrally; production custody and independent issuance remain separate gates.
Initial lab note issuance and guarantee grants are issuer-approved funding fixtures, not claims about central-bank integration.
Encrypted opening plaintext correctness, fault-tolerant recovery and native claim materialization remain separate gates.
